hints.title: Word Delimitation
hints.text: Target words must be standalone words enclosed by surrounding spaces.

hints.title: Pattern Matching
hints.text: Filter records containing the target word surrounded by spaces to prevent partial substring matches.

hints.title: Combine Row Counts
hints.text: Count matching entries for each word independently and combine them into a single table with union all.

hints.title: SQL String Match Union
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT 'bull' AS word, COUNT(*) AS count FROM Files WHERE content LIKE '% bull %'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'bear' AS word, COUNT(*) AS count FROM Files WHERE content LIKE '% bear %';
```

complexity.time: O(N * L) where N is number of files and L is text length
variables: N: number of records in Files
complexity.notes: Scans text content for space-padded word patterns.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Matching substrings without space delimiters erroneously catches composite words like bullet or bears.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two independent scans over the table combined via union.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses string pattern matching with space boundaries to identify standalone words.
